name: new_document
description: Create a new .docx from a template (blank|report|memo|letter|proposal|invoice|technical-spec|research-paper|novel|newsletter; default blank, an empty page) at outPath inside an allowed folder (a template is a starting document with styles, page setup, header and footer and bracketed placeholders such as [Client name]; every part can be edited afterwards). Optional page {size,orientation,margins} sets the paper (Letter default; Legal, Tabloid, Executive, Statement, Folio, A3, A4, A5, A6, B4, B5, B6, or any size such as "148x210mm" or {"width":"6in","height":"9in"}, 1 in to 22 in a side), landscape, and margins (one length such as "20mm", or {top,bottom,left,right,header,footer,gutter}); the template is built for that page. The old pageSize option was replaced by page.size. (the folders named with --allowed-dir or ASTRA_EXTRA_DOC_ROOTS; only when none are named, ./documents and the system temp folder). Validates the fresh package before writing (E_VALIDATION when invalid, never writes corruption); refuses to overwrite without {force:true} (E_CONFLICT). Success returns {ok:true,path,sessionId,revision,template,bytes} with the file opened into a session (use sessionId for inspect/execute_batch/save). Example {"outPath":"documents/new-report.docx","template":"report"}. Session ids are server-minted (sess_<uuid>, DEPRECATED to supply sessionId: client-supplied values are rejected with E_VALIDATION; deterministic ids are test-only via --allow-client-session-ids). IDs are session-scoped: valid only in the issuing session, must not be stored across sessions. Optional styleGuide (bundled guide name or guide .md path, jailed to the document folder; remote URLs fail closed) attaches a house style to the session at creation: later batches inherit its table/chart/callout defaults, inspect_document shows its compact summary, save_document reports advisory styleWarnings. Guides cannot be detached afterwards: open a new session to work without a guide. Unknown names fail with E_VALIDATION naming the available set.

page.description: The page of the new document: { size: a paper name (Letter, Legal, Tabloid, Executive, Statement, Folio, A3, A4, A5, A6, B4, B5, B6) or a size such as "148x210mm" or { width, height }, orientation, margins }. Default Letter portrait.

sessionId.description: DEPRECATED: session ids are server-minted (sess_<uuid>); omit sessionId and use the returned id. Client-supplied values are rejected with E_VALIDATION (deterministic ids are test-only via --allow-client-session-ids).

__schema0.description: A paper name (Letter, Legal, Tabloid, Executive, Statement, Folio, A3, A4, A5, A6, B4, B5, B6), a size {width, height} with lengths, or a string such as "148x210mm" or "6x9in"

__schema3.description: A length: a number of twips (1440 to an inch), or a string with a unit such as "25mm", "1in", "2.5cm", "72pt"

__schema6.description: portrait or landscape; a named paper is portrait unless this says landscape

__schema8.description: One length for all four page margins, or an object with any of top, bottom, left, right, header (distance), footer (distance) and gutter
